name: Southern Plains Grassland Program
summary: Grants for on-the-ground grassland conservation in the Southern Great Plains: improved grazing management, grassland restoration, woody invasive removal and fence modification for wildlife.

geography.label: Southern Great Plains (eastern Colorado to the Texas Panhandle)

reporting: Applicants pick the most relevant project metrics from the programme's list in NFWF's Easygrants system for future reporting.

eligibility.rule: Project is in Eastern Colorado, Kansas, Southern Nebraska, Northeastern New Mexico, Oklahoma or Texas Panhandle
Not a for-profit entity or unincorporated individual
Project is not ongoing legal compliance (permit conditions, mitigation, settlements)

documents: Board of Trustees or Directors list, or a statement that none exists
GAAP Audited Financial Statements, unless current valid information is already on file in Easygrants
IRS Form 990, unless current valid information is already on file in Easygrants
Single Audit, unless current valid information is already on file in Easygrants

eligibility.quote: Projects in the following areas are eligible for Southern Plains Grasslands support: Eastern Colorado, Kansas, Southern Nebraska, Northeastern New Mexico, Oklahoma, and the Texas Panhandle.
Ineligible applicants include for-profit entities and unincorporated individuals.

NFWF funds may not be used to support ongoing efforts to comply with legal requirements, including permit conditions, mitigation, and settlement agreements. However, grant funds may be used to support projects that enhance or improve upon existing baseline compliance efforts.
